summary: Romania's military shot down an unidentified drone in its airspace this week, adding another data point to an increasingly active period for UAP-related incidents and disclosure pressure. The Pentagon is simultaneously investigating a mysterious event reported by the Navy off Virginia's coast, while the All-domain Anomaly Resolution Office (AARO) released its delayed FY2025 report documenting 319 new cases and expanded satellite analysis. On the public pressure front, Dr. Phil amplified calls for transparency on NewsNation, characterizing the government's shielding of UAP files as patronizing and pointing to what he describes as a massive cover-up. Meanwhile, reports suggest a prepared UAP disclosure speech exists within White House circles, and investigative journalist Ross Coulthart continues asserting the Pentagon knows substantially more than it publicly acknowledges. The week underscores a widening gap between official disclosures, documented incidents, and public figures demanding concrete answers rather than more ambiguous footage.
